The function $\delta$ measures the chordal distance between $L(j\omega)$ and the critical point $-1$ at each frequency. The smallest distance determines the margin in {eq:bncf}, and a small distance indicates proximity to instability. All branches of the estimator use the capped distance

The identity $|1+L|^{2}-(1+|L|^{2})=2\,\mathrm{Re}\,L$ shows that the distance exceeds $\delta(0)=1/\sqrt{2}$ only where $\mathrm{Re}\,L>0$.
